notes.title: Release? Release!
notes.notes:
We're done! This is our first release on Steam and we hope that you were satisfied :) 
 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/3b10a95ae6c1712a451cab6384a9d52bc402c53b.jpg 
Thanks to everyone who supported and guided us, you are great fellows!
The list of changes will not be, because there is nothing significant.
At the moment we are working on a new game (about knights, but this is inside information) and will be glad to see you again!

 If there are any wishes or comments on Mr. Sweet - do not hesitate to share with us, we will do everything:)

notes.title: Okay, one more update. 0.8.8
notes.notes:
Well, if you're interested:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/5ad2c55e86a8e336afbdcfc796e8018728a7244c.png


Increased the collection area of the coin bonus "Collector"
Added new levels
New platforms added
Added new traps
Changed some platforms
Notification of the next level opening
Added game cursor
Reduced prices for some characters
Increased speed of movement between the running lines
In some levels, the speed of the character's run is reduced


We went to drink Russian vodka
Have a nice day

notes.title: Update 0.7.3! Hell, we're close
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm George and I came to show a cool picture:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/af5009745bcf8fffbd968ce5c798edcd990c17bb.png

Teaser

The list of changes today will be brief

A new universe is open: Fast Food World

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/d5254cabfdbee6c3b9067d794f1f332378a24c79.png

Added 2 new levels to the first universe

New music: The Multiverse (and it has a low price)

Redesign of the pause menu

Many bug fixes

A huge number of small and boring changes, for this reason I will not mention them :)

notes.title: Whaaaaat?! Update 0.4.6?! Yes
notes.notes:
So, what did we add:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/2e0b582dda18ed298bd55486d7d03e9a02e6854d.png


 Added a new trap: Bomb on the floor (and it's adorable) 

 Countdown at the beginning of the level is now animated 

 Treason the form of some barricades, now you will crash a little less but still a lot 

 Completely remade the main menu 

 Added new music: The Colony 

 Added new music: Heavy Wave 

 Added preview of levels 

 The distances needed to open new levels are reduced 

 Added the ability to use superpowers on the right Shift 

 Huge heads now move their teeth not synchronously 

 The initial speed is slightly reduced and the height of the usual jump is increased 

 Fixed a bug when simultaneously pressing both Shift keys the abilities were triggered twice, sometimes it was funny, it's a pity that you will not see it 

 Reduced the cost of music (all music) 

 Added a little bit of optimization and increased the number of simultaneously existing platforms. Now it looks like they were always there, and did not appear in front of your nose just now 

 Some unpleasant things will not bother you in person anymore 


 And many more small and boring changes

notes.title: Big Bad Bomb! (Will be in the next update)
notes.notes:
Well, we rested a week after the release. 
Yes, we did not do anything for a week at all. In my opinion it's great, but it's time to get down to business! 

And the first thing we did was a huge bomb!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/54f0d6639309aa5f50814f1fa82f489bac9a69ae.jpg

Soon we will publish changelist :)

notes.title: Update 0.4.0!
notes.notes:
The first update is always exciting, but we will try not to cry!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557193/38be5c62839a34141efc393cc0460a9db1351629.png

*Added new character: Mr. Maven

*Added character descriptions

*Added abilities to characters:
Mrs. Sweet - Sweet jump
Candy Police - Sweet sprint
Mr. Zombie - DONUTS! (You eat a donut-barricade and get 15 coins for each)
Ninja - Ghost mode
French Fries - Emergency stop
Mr. Erudite - Jetpack
Mr. Tunod - Sweet double (the first "Shift" to create a clone, the second "Shift" to move to it)
Mr. Maven - Sweet magnet
Mr. Evil Baking - Laundering of sweetcoins (5 coins for 1)

*Added new music

*Reduced prices for characters and music in the store

*Improved system of collisions, now you will hit less often :)

Changed the coins icon in the menu

*Changed some types of platforms

*The height of the standard "jump" is changed

We wish you a pleasant game!
